name: useDisplay
summary: Refresh rate, HDR capability, brightness and the screen wake lock.
plain: Reads what the screen is doing and lets you influence it. The refresh rate changes constantly on this panel to save power, so it is re-read live rather than assumed.
description: Display mode, supported refresh rates, HDR types and resolution come from the Android Display object through the native module, re-read every two seconds because adaptive refresh rate changes the active mode continuously. Brightness uses expo-brightness and the wake lock uses expo-keep-awake. setPreferredRefreshRate requests a rate; the platform may ignore it, so read refreshRateHz back rather than assuming it took.

returns.name: refreshRateHz
returns.desc: Rate the panel is running at right now. Changes on its own with adaptive refresh.

returns.name: hasArrSupport
returns.desc: Whether adaptive refresh rate is supported.

returns.name: supportedRefreshRates
returns.desc: Every rate the panel can drive, down to 1 Hz on this device.

returns.name: resolution
returns.desc: Physical resolution and density of the active mode.

returns.name: hdrTypes
returns.desc: Supported HDR formats: 1 Dolby Vision, 2 HDR10, 3 HLG, 4 HDR10+.

returns.name: isHdr
returns.desc: Whether the panel reports HDR capability at all.

returns.name: maxLuminance
returns.desc: Peak luminance the panel reports, when it reports one.

returns.name: isKeepAwake
returns.desc: Whether this app is currently holding the screen on.

returns.name: source
returns.desc: Where the numbers came from. There is no 'simulated' value: a reading is real, derived from real readings, or unavailable.

actions.name: setPreferredRefreshRate(hz)
actions.desc: Asks the system for a refresh rate for this window, for example 120 during an animation and 60 otherwise.
actions.output: Resolves true when the request was applied. It is a request, not a guarantee: the system may pick another mode.

actions.name: setScreenBrightness(value)
actions.desc: Sets the brightness of this app window.
actions.output: Resolves once applied. No-op on web; on failure brightness is left unchanged.

actions.name: toggleKeepAwake()
actions.desc: Acquires or releases a tagged screen wake lock, so the display does not dim during a long read or capture.
actions.output: Resolves once the lock state has flipped; isKeepAwake reflects it. Release it when you no longer need it.

agentNote: Do not cache refreshRateHz; it moves. Always release the wake lock when the screen no longer needs to stay on, or you will drain the battery.
